system.description:
Surging Maelstrom – Tidal Draw

This special condition is treated as an Elemental Condition.

A creature afflicted with Tidal Draw can feel their chakra network being siphoned while kneading chakra. When a Tidal Drawn creature casts a jutsu that requires CM (Chakra Molding), the Ninjutsu specialist that inflicted this condition gains temporary chakra equal to the rank of the jutsu cast. (D-Rank/ C-Rank: 1d4, B-Rank/A-Rank: 1d8, S-Rank: 1d12).
system.summary: When it casts a jutsu with CM, the Ninjutsu Specialist who inflicted it gains temporary chakra (D/C 1d4, B/A 1d8, S 1d12). Lasts until the beginning of the inflicter's next turn.

rules.text: When it casts a jutsu that requires CM, its inflicter gains temporary chakra by the jutsu's rank (D-Rank/C-Rank 1d4, B-Rank/A-Rank 1d8, S-Rank 1d12): roll and add it at the table. Surging Maelstrom inflicts it until the beginning of your next turn.
